verses.text: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
lines: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge,
but he who hates reproof is stupid.

verses.text: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
lines: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh,
but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

verses.text: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
lines: A man shall not be established by wickedness,
but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

verses.text: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
lines: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband,
but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

verses.text: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
lines: The thoughts of the righteous are just,
but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

verses.text: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
lines: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood,
but the speech of the upright rescues them.

verses.text: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
lines: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more,
but the house of the righteous shall stand.

verses.text: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
lines: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom,
but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

verses.text: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself, and lacks bread.
lines: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant,
than he who honors himself, and lacks bread.

verses.text: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
lines: A righteous man respects the life of his animal,
but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

verses.text: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
lines: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread,
but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

verses.text: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
lines: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men,
but the root of the righteous flourishes.

verses.text: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
lines: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips,
but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

verses.text: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
lines: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth.
The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

verses.text: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
lines: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes,
but he who is wise listens to counsel.

verses.text: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
lines: A fool shows his annoyance the same day,
but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

verses.text: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
lines: He who is truthful testifies honestly,
but a false witness lies.

verses.text: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
lines: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword,
but the tongue of the wise heals.

verses.text: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
lines: Truth’s lips will be established forever,
but a lying tongue is only momentary.

verses.text: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
lines: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil,
but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

verses.text: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
lines: No mischief shall happen to the righteous,
but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

verses.text: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
lines: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh,
but those who do the truth are his delight.

verses.text: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
lines: A prudent man keeps his knowledge,
but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

verses.text: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
lines: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule,
but laziness ends in slave labor.

verses.text: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
lines: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down,
but a kind word makes it glad.

verses.text: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
lines: A righteous person is cautious in friendship,
but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

verses.text: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
lines: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game,
but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

verses.text: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
lines: In the way of righteousness is life;
in its path there is no death.
